definitions.explanation: Corrugated cardboard material, or a box made from it. One of the most common packaging materials. Also used to refer to cardboard boxes specifically.

examples.japanese: {段|だん}ボール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畳|たた}んで→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷造|にづく}り→荷造り：07938_nizukuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{段|だん}ボール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十|じゅっ}{箱|ぱこ}⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: I need ten cardboard boxes for packing for the move.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{段|だん}ボール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧⟦{溜|た}まって→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧しまう。
examples.english: When you shop online, cardboard boxes keep piling up.

notes:
USAGE:
An everyday word. In Japan, used cardboard must be flattened and bundled for recycling on designated collection days. Often shortened to {段|だん}ボール{箱|ばこ} when emphasizing the box form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {段|だん}ボール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畳|たた}む→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧ (to flatten cardboard)
- {段|だん}ボール{箱|ばこ} (cardboard box)
- {段|だん}ボール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ (to pack into a cardboard box)
- {段|だん}ボール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to throw out cardboard)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Cardboard recycling is a standard part of Japanese waste separation (⟦ゴミ{分別|ぶんべつ}→ゴミ分別：08732_gomibunbetsu⟧). Flattened cardboard is typically collected on specific days separate from other recyclables.
